g.text: Default log record (tool name and target, no arguments)
cmd: just gateway-mcp-log-check | pass: prints 'default-record: tool_name_and_target=True arguments_present=False'
cmd: just gateway-mcp-log-check | pass: prints 'opt-in-record: tool_arguments={...}' containing the canary argument
cmd: just gateway-mcp-log-check | pass: prints 'PASS gateway-mcp-log' and podman ps -a lists no wattson-gw-mcplog
